messages.content: Create a beginner Teach Mode exercise at 120 BPM with middle Sa followed by Re, one beat each. Do not start it for me.

tools.name: load_lesson
tools.description: Load a strict beat-based lesson into Teach Mode. This replaces the current lesson but never starts it; the human presses Start.

tools.name: get_lesson_progress
tools.description: Read Teach Mode lesson timing, accuracy, wrong-note count, and per-note results.

tools.name: clear_lesson
tools.description: Stop and remove the current Teach Mode lesson. The page remains in Teach Mode.
